issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

imageParserSpec.description:
Defines the image parser spec (optional). If the param is not passed,
even if #disableImageParser is set to False, then the image parsing will be skipped.

tableParserSpec.description:
Defines the table parser spec (optional). If the param is not passed,
even if #disableTableParser is set to False, then the table parsing will be skipped.

disableImageParser.description: Disable the Image parser (default: False). If set to True, then the image parsing will be skipped.

disableTableParser.description: Disable the Table parser (default: False). If set to True, then the table parsing will be skipped.
